micah: Proposal: make gateway enforce workspace-scoped routing for dedicated pools when a request comes from a VPC/private endpoint. Right now header hints can trump VPC binding and we've seen a few cross-tenant hits.

lina: Saw 3 incidents last month where user-supplied X-Workspace was mismatched and traffic landed in wrong pool. :grimacing: logs: `pool=dedicated-ws-42 src=vpc-cust-a hint=ws-99`.

kai: Curious — does this mean header hints become advisory only when VPC-binding is present? How would this impact canary routing and rollouts?

micah: Exactly. Proposed semantics (short):

```
# current (pseudo)
if header.X-Workspace -> route by header
elif vpc.binding -> route by vpc
else -> default routing

# proposed
if vpc.binding -> require workspace == vpc.workspace && route to dedicated pool
elif header.X-Workspace verified -> route by header
else -> default
```

Keep header hint for non-VPC paths, but make VPC binding authoritative. This avoids accidental cross-tenant assignments.

debra: That sounds safe, but we need metrics before/after. Add metric `scoped_ejection.count` and a per-pool `header_override.attempts`. Console should surface both and allow quick rollback.

micah: Plan: add a feature-flagged rollout (gateway flag: `enforce_vpc_workspace_scope`) -> enable in staging -> collect metrics for 48h -> small prod cohort -> ramp. Telemetry events: `routing.decision(source=vpc|header|fallback, reason=workspace_mismatch|...)`.

kai: For canaries: if a dedicated pool is in the middle of a rollout between model versions, does forcing vpc workspace scoping change affinity? Need to confirm KV cache / session stickiness behavior. If we reassign based on strict workspace, sessions might detach.

lina: Good point. Add a preflight that checks `session.affinity_impact` and warn if >2% sessions would rebind. Also we should patch the console rollout UI to show "expected affinity delta" next to canary controls.

debra: Security asked to include an audit log entry whenever header hint is disregarded: `audit: header_hint_ignored {request_id, workspace_hint, vpc_binding, pool_selected}`. They want retention 90d for private endpoints.

opsbot: deploy-check: gateway unit tests - 12 failures (routing spec). See CI: https://ci.internal.redwood/gateway/21401.

micah: I'll pick up the tests. Action items: 1) Lina adds metrics + alert (P0 if ejection_rate>1% for any prod pool). 2) Kai runs session-affinity preflight on 3 representative workspaces. 3) Debra wires audit log + console UI hint. 4) Micah patches tests and flips feature flag in staging.

lina: noted. creating a metrics PR now -> will tag @micah for review. :thumbsup:

kai: I'll simulate canaries and post results later today.

micah: Thanks. If anyone sees more cross-tenant hits, drop logs here or ping @oncall.

lina: quick config example for prod gate (to attach to PR):
```
gateway.features.enforce_vpc_workspace_scope: true  # feature-flag
gateway.metrics.emit: ["routing.decision","scoped_ejection.count","header_override.attempts"]
gateway.audit.header_hint_ignored.retention_days: 90
```

debra: One more: console should expose a per-workspace "dedicated pool bindings" view so SREs can quickly assert which pools are bound to which VPCs. Saves a 10-min lookup.

micah: Agreed. Will add to console backlog after staging validation. :rocket:
